verdict.rationale: Logseq describes itself as an "open-source knowledge base" [logseq-docs-23]. A community user independently cites "source availability" as a reason for choosing it [logseq-comm-7], and another references its public GitHub issue tracker [logseq-comm-20]. Missing for 10: the specific open license is never named, there is no link to the source repository, and there are no docs on reading or building the source.
